title: Place a Vault component by item revision HRID
summary: Looks up a component item revision in an installed Vault by its HRID (IEDMS_Vault.ItemRevisionByHRID) and starts placing it into the active document with IDXPWorkSpace.DM_UseItemRevision. Shows the Vault, item and revision GUIDs that call needs.
phrasings: place a workspace component on a schematic from code
find an item revision by its HRID
get the vault GUID and item GUID of a component

commands.name: PlaceVaultComponent
commands.description: Look up a Vault item revision by HRID and start placing it into the active document
commands.params: Hrid=<item revision HRID, required; the menu passes CMP-0001-00000-1>|Vault=<index, default 0>|DryRun=<true: look up only, do not place>
